statement: You are given two integer arrays a and b, each sorted in non-decreasing order. Either array may contain repeated values.
The union of a and b is the set of distinct values that appear in at least one of them.
Return the union as a list in increasing order, with each value listed once.

examples.explanation: 2 and 3 occur in both arrays but are listed once; 5 comes only from b.
Only 2 is shared. Every other value appears in exactly one of the arrays.
Repeats inside each array collapse too, leaving the distinct values 1, 2 and 3.

constraints: a and b are sorted in non-decreasing order
